name: Sandbox Swapmeet
blurb: Dubai collectibles swapmeet with trading cards, comics, anime, K-pop and cosplay communities, now in its ninth volume.
notes: Dubai page's own 'Upcoming Events' section says: 'Card Trade Show, Sticker Con and Sandbox Swapmeet Volume 9 is coming soon! Stay tuned at our Instagram account' - no date announced yet, matching the fixup note. Most recent confirmed Dubai edition is Volume 8, May 28-31 2026 at Dubai World Trade Centre. The brand also runs separate Abu Dhabi events (sandboxswapmeet.me/events/abu-dhabi) not covered by this Dubai-only id.
